title: feat(daemon): COPILOT is a recognized worker.type
description:
Slice 1 of task-59e1d150 (GitHub Copilot CLI as a fifth agent provider; that row is the closing integration row). No dependency: it can land first.

OBJECTIVE. A seat whose wrapper launched GitHub Copilot CLI registers as worker.type COPILOT. The wrappers export MOE_WORKER_TYPE=COPILOT (task-ab323f85), and moe-proxy already forwards that value verbatim as workerType on claim_next_task and join_team. But normalizeWorkerType in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/joinTeam.ts maps anything outside CLAUDE, CODEX, GEMINI and GROK to CLAUDE.

DELIVERABLE:
- 'COPILOT' in WorkerType (packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts), in WORKER_TYPES and in WORKER_TYPE_SCHEMA's description (joinTeam.ts; claim_next_task reuses that schema). Record<WorkerType, true> makes tsc enforce the list.
- New cases in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/workerType.test.ts.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md (join_team and claim_next_task workerType) and docs/SCHEMA.md (WorkerType) name COPILOT.
Additive only: the exact, case-sensitive match and the CLAUDE default for any other value stay.

NOT IN SCOPE: the wrappers (task-ab323f85); moe-proxy's comment listing the types (the docs slice); VS Code's WorkerType type (task-7739d4af); the board UI (JetBrains reads worker.type as a free string, MoeJson.kt:732).

VERIFICATION (global rail: never npm ci/build/test in the live checkout): in a git-archive snapshot outside the repo, cd packages/moe-daemon && npm ci && npm run build && npx vitest run src/tools/workerType.test.ts.
definitionOfDone: moe.join_team and moe.claim_next_task with workerType 'COPILOT' record worker.type COPILOT, and an existing CLAUDE record refreshes to COPILOT, proven by new cases in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/workerType.test.ts
workerType 'copilot', 'Copilot' and ' COPILOT ' still record CLAUDE, proven by the same file
WorkerType in packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts and WORKER_TYPES and WORKER_TYPE_SCHEMA's description in joinTeam.ts include COPILOT, and npm run build passes in the snapshot
docs/MCP_SERVER.md (join_team, claim_next_task) and docs/SCHEMA.md (WorkerType) list COPILOT among the worker types
In a git-archive snapshot outside the live checkout, cd packages/moe-daemon && npm ci && npm run build && npx vitest run src/tools/workerType.test.ts exits 0
